mood.summary: Markets are mixed and cautious ahead of Fed Chair Warsh's key speech at the Jackson Hole symposium. An AI-fueled rally shows signs of pausing, creating a choppy, wait-and-see environment.

indicesNarrative: US futures are mixed as the market pauses after a tech-led rally. All eyes are on Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's speech at Jackson Hole for future monetary policy signals. The Nasdaq is showing some pre-market weakness as the AI-fueled momentum cools, while the Dow is slightly positive.

Fed Chair Warsh Speaks at Jackson Hole Symposium

alert: All eyes on Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech today for monetary policy clues.

news.headline: US stock futures are mixed as traders await Fed Chair Warsh's key speech at the Jackson Hole economic symposium.
PayPal shares plunge over 14% in pre-market after a report that a buyout consortium abandoned its acquisition plans.
Marvell Technology drops over 8% pre-market as its strong results and outlook failed to meet elevated investor expectations for AI growth.
Gap shares jump 17% pre-market after raising its annual profit forecast and appointing a new CEO for its Old Navy brand.
Asian markets were mixed overnight, while European markets traded higher, showing a cautious global sentiment.
